title: Integral bounds for a cutoff function
statement: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on $\mathbb R$, and let $\phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous with $0\le\phi(x)\le1$ for every $x$. Suppose there are real numbers $u,v$ such that $\phi(x)=1$ whenever $x\le u$, and $\phi(x)=0$ whenever $v\le x$. Then $\mu((-�infty,u])\le\int\phi\,d\mu\le\mu((-�infty,v])$, where the measure terms are viewed as real numbers.
